senses.gloss: to rise, go up; to go away.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 19:28">Targ. Gen. XIX, 28</cite> (Y. ed. Amst. <cite ref="O01026"><he>סַלִּיק</he></cite>). Ib. XXXII, 27 (Y. ed. Amst. <cite ref="O01026"><he>סַלִּיק</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 13:18">Targ. Ex. XIII, 18</cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Beitzah 38a:9">Bets. 38ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>כי ס׳ ר׳ וכ׳</he> when R. A. went up (from Babylonia to Palestine); <cite ref="Beitzah 38a:9">ib.</cite> <he>כי ס׳ להתם</he> Ms. M. when he arrived there; a. fr.

<cite ref="Taanit 21a:11">Taan. 21ᵃ</cite> <he>כל מילתא דהוה סַלְקָא ליה הוה אמר וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>כל דהוה ס׳ ביה</he>) whatever happened to him, he said, this, too, is for good; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 108b:22">Snh. 108ᵇ</cite> bot.; a. fr.

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Judges 3:19">Targ. Jud. III, 19</cite>; <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Amos 6:10">Targ. Am. VI, 10</cite>; <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Amos 8:3">VIII, 3</cite> (h. text <he>הס</he>).

senses.gloss: to turn out, result, (with אליבא) to agree with.
units: <cite ref="Targum of I Chronicles 11:11">Targ. I Chr. XI, 11</cite>.—
B. Kam. 92ᵃ bot. לא הוה סלקא ליה שמעתא וכ׳ Ms. H. (ed. סליק, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 30) whatever tradition he reported turned out not to be in agreement with the halakha

senses.gloss: with על ליבא, דעתא &c. (= h. עלה על לב) to occur to the mind; to desire; to entertain an opinion.
units: <cite ref="Targum of II Chronicles 7:11">Targ. II Chr. VII, 11</cite>.—In Talm. <he>סלקא דעתא</he> = <he>סלק אד׳</he>, v. <cite ref="D00951"><he>דַּעְתָּא</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Chullin 64b:4">Ḥull. 64ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>לא ס״ד</he> that cannot rise in your mind, no idea of it.

senses.gloss: (cmp. עלתה ארוכה העלה ארוכה, v. אֲרוּכָה II) to grow, heal up.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 134b:8">Sabb. 134ᵇ</cite>, a. e., v. <cite ref="E00362"><he>הַיָיא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Ezekiel 45:9">Targ. Ez. XLV, 9</cite> (not <he>סְלִי׳</he>).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 34:29">Targ. Job XXXIV, 29</cite> (not <he>ויסלף</he>).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 102:25">Targ. Ps. CII, 25</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Niddah 51b:43">Nidd. 51ᵇ</cite> <he>בתר דסַלִּיקוּ וכ׳</he> after they have taken off their phylacteries.
<cite ref="Gittin 52b:6">Gitt. 52ᵇ</cite> <he>ואֵיסַלְּקִינֵיה</he> and I shall remove him (from office).
<cite ref="Gittin 52b:6">Ib.</cite> <he>מְסַלְּקִינָן ליה</he> we (the court) must discharge him; a. fr.

senses.gloss: (with or without בזוזא) to dismiss with payment; to settle, satisfy.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 68a:3">B. Mets. 68ᵃ</cite> <he>מצי מְסַלֵּק ליה</he> he has a right to settle with him (satisfy the mortgage).
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 67a">Ib. 67ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="M02910"><he>מַשְׁכַּנְתָּא</he></cite>; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to remove one’s self, rise, go away; to be removed, taken away; to die.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 12:8">Targ. Gen. XII, 8</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum of I Chronicles 5:1">Targ. I Chr. V, 1</cite> (ed. Lag. a. oth. <he>אשתקלת</he>); a. fr.—
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 12:43">Targ. Y. Ex. XII, 43</cite> <he>דא׳</he> who deserted the Jewish faith (O. ed. Berl. <he>דאשתמד</he>; oth. ed. <he>דאסתלק</he>; h. text <he>בן נכר</he>).—
<cite ref="Ketubot 106a:2">Keth. 106ᵃ</cite> <he>כיון דעבד הכי א׳</he> after he had done this, he (Elijah) stayed away (ceased to appear to him); a. fr.

<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 27a:4">R. Hash. 27ᵃ</cite> <he>תִּיסְּלֵק לה בתרתי</he> let it be accounted as two notes.—[<cite ref="Berakhot 56b">Ber. 56ᵇ</cite> <he>אסתליק</he> Ms. M., v. <cite ref="R00549"><he>צְלַק</he></cite>.]
